name: Anthem of the Sun
bio: Anthem of the Sun is a Ventura Grateful Dead tribute band, formerly known as Peoples Dead. They host Ventura Dead Night on Thursdays at 7pm at Winchester's Grill & Saloon downtown.
bio_source: Written by TOPA from @anthemofthesun.band and venturagratefuldead.com.
source: public web search and the band's public Instagram profile, 2026-10-29
